# `/role-propagation` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /role-propagation/v1

`startRolePropagationV1` — Initiate Role Propagation process — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint initiates a role change propagation process for a tenant asynchronously. If all preconditions are met, the request is accepted and a rolePropagationId is returned which can be used to view the status. API throws 4xx if any of the following conditions are met - Role propagation feature is disabled - There is an ongoing role propagation for the tenant - Role refresh needs to be kicked off as part of the role propagation (skipRoleRefresh=false) and there is an ongoing refresh for…

- Scopes: idn:role-propagation:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, API, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `skipRoleRefresh` (query) — default False — When true, the role refresh is not performed. Keeping it false is recommended.
- Returns 202: role-propagation-response

### GET /role-propagation/v1/{rolePropagationId}/status

`getRolePropagationStatusV1` — Get status of Role-Propagation process — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint returns the information of the specified role change propagation process. The execution stage of the role propagation process can be one of the following: - PENDING - The role propagation process is queued to be executed. - DATA_AGGREGATION_RUNNING - The role propagation process is currently aggregating data. - LAUNCH_PROVISIONING - The role propagation process has started to provision the access to the identities. - SUCCEEDED - The role propagation process has successfully…

- Scopes: idn:role-propagation:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, API, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `rolePropagationId` (path, required) — The ID of the role propagation process to retrieve the status for.
- Returns 200: role-propagation-status-response

### GET /role-propagation/v1/is-running

`getOngoingRolePropagationV1` — Get ongoing Role Propagation process — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint returns the information of ongoing role change propagation process for a tenant. It returns the information whether the role propagation process is currently running or not, If it is running it returns the details of the ongoing role propagation process. The execution stage of the role propagation process can be one of the following: - PENDING - The role propagation process is queued to be executed. - DATA_AGGREGATION_RUNNING - The role propagation process is currently…

- Scopes: idn:role-propagation:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, API, HELPDESK
- Returns 200: role-propagation-ongoing-response

### POST /role-propagation/v1/terminate

`cancelRolePropagationV1` — Terminate Role Propagation process — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint terminates the ongoing role change propagation process for a tenant.

- Scopes: idn:role-propagation:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, API, HELPDESK
- Returns 204: no body
